dct_description_sm: The objectives of subgroup 7 were as follows: 1 - to determine the responses of benthic community structure to seasonal variations in sedimentation on an Arctic continental shelf 2 - to determine the responses of benthic community structure to variations in the magnitude and frequency of ice scours on an Arctic continental shelf 3 - to assess the impact of 1) and 2) on the rate of carbon remineralization in Arctic shelf sediments 4 - to perform an examination of the utility of biogeochemical  markers in invertebrate skeletons as proxies for the various sources of organic materials consumed by Arctic shelf benthos.
dct_title_s: Benthic abundance and diversity of the Canadian Beaufort Sea
